# gitea_repository_signing_key (Data Source)

Fetches repository signing keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_repository_signing_key" "example" {
  repository_owner = "my-org"
  repository       = "my-repo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository` (String) The repository name.
- `repository_owner` (String) The repository owner.

### Read-Only

- `gpg_public_key` (String) The repository GPG signing key, if available.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ssh_public_key` (String) The repository SSH signing key, if available.
